name: Connected Hearts
source:
Shortly after moving out Gary has a strange dream where he meets a woman who responds to the name of Alice, who tells him he left a promise unfulfilled. That would be the beginning of a series of inexplicable events that will take him to visit different dreamlike places and to meet people he can't remember ever seeing before.

[From [url=https://eidolon-stigma.itch.io/connected-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加里搬出去后不久，做了一个奇怪的梦。在梦里，他遇见了一个名叫爱丽丝的女人。她告诉他，还有一个承诺没有兑现。

这就是一连串无法解释的事件的开端，将带他造访不同的梦境般场所，并遇见一些他从未见过、却又似乎认识的人。

[来源：[url=https://eidolon-stigma.itch.io/connected-hearts]itch.io[/url]]
